stem:
Meena notices that the iron gate at her school in Jaipur develops brown rust during the rainy season.

Iron rusts only when it is in contact with ……1…… .

Rusting of the gate can be prevented by ……2…… its surface with paint or oil.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

options.text: 1 both air and water; 2 leaving uncovered
1 either air or water; 2 leaving uncovered

tables: {"headers":["","1","2"],"rows":[["A","both air and water","leaving uncovered"],["B","both air and water","covering"],["C","either air or water","leaving uncovered"],["D","either air or water","covering"]],"row_labels":["A","B","C","D"],"caption":"","is_option_table":true}

teacher.key_rationale: Iron rusts only when both air (oxygen) and water are present together, so gap 1 is 'both air and water'. Painting, oiling or greasing blocks contact with air and water, so gap 2 is 'covering'. Hence B. Option D traps students who know prevention but think either air or water alone causes rust; A traps those who know the conditions but reverse the prevention idea.
